name: substring-assignment
source:
S$="abcdef"
T$=S$
Right$(S$,4)="XY"
Print S$,T$
Mid$(S$,3,2)=S$
Print S$
Left$(S$,2)="Z"
Mid$(S$,99,-1)="!"
Print S$
Mid$(S$,0)="1234567"
Print S$
S$=""
Left$(S$,-1)="X"
Print S$
S$="a"+Chr$(0)+"b"+Chr$(255)
Mid$(S$,2)=S$
Print S$

encoding.notes: Independent opcode/payload assembly using explicit original C_Tk offsets Left$=0x0528, Right$=0x0536, three-argument Mid$=0x050e and two-argument Mid$=0x051e. Production token table/encoder are not imported. The final literal contains raw bytes 61 00 62 ff; readable source spells those bytes using Chr$.

evidence.notes: RInMid copies the destination before evaluating arguments and replacement. RInMid2 overwrites at most the selected range, remaining destination and source lengths, retaining destination length and untouched suffix. Offsets 0 and 1 select the first byte; past-end offsets return before checking a negative count. InRight selects the suffix start and copies from the beginning of its source. These instruction-derived expectations are not captured AMOS execution.
